newsitem.title: USA: Top US car dealer pleads guilty to mail fraud.
newsitem.headline: Top US car dealer pleads guilty to mail fraud.

text.p: The owner of a leading U.S. car dealership pleaded guilty on Thursday to one count of mail fraud in connection with charges he bribed executives of American Honda Motor Co.
Under a plea agreeement, the Justice Department said it would ask the U.S. District Court in Asheville, N.C, to dismiss the remaining charges against Honda dealer Rick Hendrick.
Hendrick had been charged with bribing certain corrupt executives of Honda Motor Co Ltd's American Honda into giving him an unfair advantage over other car dealers.
